title: Book One · Chapter 138: The Last Rain Box
story:
Mr Qiu has one small box with RAIN written on the top. The last marked exercise book is inside it. There are also two bent paper covers and a stack of little cards.

“May I look?” Ronan asks.

Mr Qiu lifts the lid. “With clean hands.”

Ronan has just come from school. He puts his hands behind his back.

“I will wash first.”

When he comes back, Mr Qiu is using one of the cards for a price sign. The edges are uneven, but the middle is clean.

“These can still work,” he says.

Ronan takes one. He remembers the wet books on the school table. Their pages looked much larger after the rain. Miss Wu lifted each corner carefully. Now the card is light and dry between his fingers.

“Could we use some for our street game?”

“How many?”

“I must count first.”

“Count first. Then we can talk about the price.”

Ronan goes home for Leo's list. They need six door cards, three blank cards, and a sign. They already have paper for some cards. He comes back and asks for five small cards.

Mr Qiu sets five beside the box. The cards have marks, so Mr Qiu asks less. Mum has let Ronan spend a little on school. Ronan pays from that money. It is not his bicycle money. He writes the cost on the back of the list, so Miss Wu can see it.

“And the book?” he asks.

“Still here.”

Mr Qiu opens the wavy book. The brown mark on the cover has not changed. Neither has the lower price inside it.

“I need a book for my own stock lists,” he says. “This one may be mine.”

“You are buying it from yourself?”

“I am keeping it to use for work. It is not for sale now.”

He takes the price paper out and writes his name on the front. Then he uses the first page to count pencils. Ronan watches him write on the wavy page. They once thought this book could not be used.

“Now the rain box is empty,” he says.

“Not quite.”

Mr Qiu shows him the bent covers. He will cut them down for small pads. He asks Ronan to leave them alone until he has time. He needs a sharp blade to cut them. Mr Qiu will do that part himself.

Ronan puts his five cards in an envelope and writes his name on it. Then he carries it home with both hands.

Leo counts the five cards that evening. Two have a dark edge, but the words will be in the clean middle. They turn each card both ways. Then they choose a clean place for the words. Ronan keeps the envelope and puts the cost paper inside. Miss Wu may ask, “How much did the cards cost?” He can show her this paper next week. The number is written down inside. The game now has something real for visitors to hold.

In the yard Dad has a free hour. “Shall we walk to the open space?” Dad asks. “We can throw the ball there.” The game cards can wait till tomorrow. Ronan puts them on his shelf, clear of the boat and bell, and gets his shoes.

When they come back, the sky is clear. Mr Qiu's rain box stands open on the table. The last bent cover is gone. Mr Qiu has made a small new pad. A customer can use it for a shopping list.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：uneven＝不平齐的；cost＝花费；pad＝便笺本。

情节提示：bent＝弯了的；blade＝刀片；stock list＝库存清单。

理解：1. 最后一本有痕迹的练习本怎样被使用？2. 为什么 Ronan 不能自己裁剪纸封面？
